name: FBT Swap — preview
_comment: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-11-11): the owner has no foreign card, no second account, and — after Render, Hugging Face and Koyeb all answered with a payment form — no free host that can run a container. Vercel is paused. So the only way to LOOK at the site while fixing its appearance is a browser-based dev environment, and a Codespace is the one that costs nothing and installs nothing locally. This file makes that a single click: Node 22, dependencies installed on creation, the dev server's two ports forwarded. The matching Vite change is `.app.github.dev` in server.allowedHosts — without it the forwarded URL is refused with an opaque 403. NOT a deployment: this runs `npm run dev`, not the production build.
postStartCommand: echo 'Run:  npm run dev   →  Ports tab → 5173 → Open in Browser'
